text: The 21 bus to Durham has 20 passengers. At Chester-le-Street 5 get off and 3 get on. How many are aboard now?
Which one of these letters is a vowel: B, K, O or T?
why: A, E, I, O and U are the vowels.

text: Count the feet: two farm cats plus three hens.
What is twenty-five per cent of sixty?
A chocolate bar is 4 rows of 6 squares. You snap off and eat one whole row of 6. How many squares are left?
A mum has four daughters, and each daughter has one brother. How many children does she have?
why: The four girls all share the same one brother.
